newsitems.title: Hotfix #36 Now Live!
newsitems.author: SaloAtLarian
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hey folks, [/p][p][/p][p]Our last small update, which aimed to resolve corrupted savegames affecting a number of players, seemed to have also introduced some performance issues that triggered crashes. Thank you for your patience while these were investigated!
[/p][p]A fix is now rolling out for all platforms that addresses these performance issues and some other crashes and blockers that were still affecting players.  [/p][h2][b]FIXES[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a framerate drop and eventual crash when loading a savegame.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug on Xbox where tooltips in the Inventory and Trade windows wouldn't display correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug on Mac preventing you from progressing past Character Creation after starting a character introduction cinematic on Honour Mode.[/p][/*][/list]
